No printed manual revision or firmware version is stated in any source; file-name dates and PDF metadata dates are not firmware evidence.
Manuals are Chinese only; no English DS2, IBL or ISL CANopen manual was found on the English download index.
The full normative CiA 301/402 texts were not obtained.
No vendor software, installer or archive was downloaded or executed; no hardware was contacted.
